title: Once Twice
exampleStatus: Source examples not copied; worked illustrations are independently authored in clarification.
summary: Exactly one distinct value occurs once, another occurs twice, and every remaining distinct value occurs three times. Return [valueOccurringOnce,valueOccurringTwice].
